_comment: Intent-based pools — group your money by PURPOSE, not by account. Cairn tracks each pool separately even when they share one brokerage account, using account boundaries + this file. Copy to ledger.json (git-ignored) and fill in your real account IDs.

slice_of_shared._note: Optional. Use only if this pool also owns part of the shared account. cash = dollars; positions = {ticker: shares}; vehicle_all = a ticker whose entire balance in the shared account belongs to this pool.

premium_split._note: Option premium is split into two buckets. Orders whose id is listed count toward owner_pool; everything else goes to default_pool.
